title: A Certifying MCKP Framework for $Γ$-Robust Discrete Pricing
summary: We study finite-menu portfolio pricing under a ratio margin requirement, price-admissibility constraints, and integer-budget demand uncertainty. The pricing model reduces exactly to a multiple-choice knapsack problem (MCKP), while the coupled robust constraint is equivalent to a finite family of fixed-threshold MCKPs indexed by zero and every original option deviation.
